notes: This 'template' is really a FILLED Homeport II / McLaren example, so tokenizing means replacing live client values rather than placeholders. Verification below asserts none of them survive.

The To/Date header block is built on TAB STOPS, not a table. A long {{PROJECT_NAME}} + add-service number overflows the column and the wrap returns to the left margin. 'MADE Bush Terminal Task 1 Add Service 3' (39 chars) breaks; 'Homeport II CA Add Service 7' (28) fits. Real fix is converting that block to a 2-column table.

Four values were split across XML runs and are NOT literal strings in document.xml: the date, the project/add-service line, the scope title, and the first fee. Only the run-tolerant engine finds them.
STORAGE_PATH clears the leftover \\hq.setty.com marketing path pointing at the old Homeport job.
